name: flightdeck
description: Monitor the main agent and its subagents in a live dashboard that brings together model usage, permission requests, task activity and session logs.
sourceDescription: Flightdeck: a live agent dashboard for Claude Code. Main model vitals, an on-call architect, every permission check, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, all from real session events
author: Stephen Casella

category.label: Agent Mods
category.basis: Coordinates agents or makes their actual work visible.
